semiconductor_relevance: Medium — AGRU provides high-quality piping systems and components that are critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes, particularly in the transport of ultra-pure media.
summary: AGRU Plastic Technology Pvt Ltd specializes in engineering plastics, offering a range of high-quality piping systems and components essential for semiconductor production. Their PURAD piping system is designed for transporting ultra-pure media and aggressive chemicals, making it suitable for various applications in the semiconductor and microelectronics industries.
